question: In the Illinois Municipal Retirement Fund (IMRF) sample RFP for domestic equity small cap growth investment management, on what factors are respondents evaluated and ranked during the selection process?
expected_facts: Four primary factors: (a) People - stability of the organization, ownership structure and documented experience of key professionals; (b) Process - clearly defined, reasonable and repeatable investment strategy; (c) Performance - documented ability to meet investment performance benchmarks; (d) Pricing - fee schedule and associated costs.
acceptance: Accept People, Process, Performance, Pricing and faithful descriptions; exact labels are not mandatory.
